what: New brainstorm external launches lack dirty-tree recovery
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed Cursor/Codex brainstorm slots can mutate the worktree; without the same post-collection sidecar/checkpoint gate used by sketches, Step 1d.5 can silently continue on a polluted tree
suggested_fix: Add a brainstorm collection boundary that consults ${OUTPUT}.dirty-tree sidecars, runs check-mid-run-dirty-tree.sh --mode checkpoint, writes dirty-tree-detected.env with STAGE=brainstorm-collection, and prompts once via a .dirty-tree-prompted-brainstorm-collection sentinel

scenario_or_breakage: The global continuation reminder currently says 1c→1d→1e; after adding Step 1d.5 this conflicts with the new required path and can cause an executor to jump directly to Gate A
suggested_fix: Update the anti-halt sequence to 1c→1d→1d.5→1e and add a structural assertion so future step insertions keep the sequence aligned

what: Trivial-plus-brainstorm upgrade relies on an unpinned mental override
scenario_or_breakage: After the Upgrade to --simple choice, $ARGUMENTS still contains --trivial; the Step 0b parser/tier mapping can still classify the run as trivial unless the effective tier override is explicit and tested
suggested_fix: Define an effective_tier variable set by Pre-Step-0, require Step 0b to use it instead of raw argv tier flags when present, and add a structure or harness check for --trivial --brainstorm upgrade producing simple/full run params

what: New brainstorm prompt harness is not wired into lint
scenario_or_breakage: The plan creates skills/design/scripts/test-brainstorm-prompts.sh but does not add a Makefile target/shard or docs entry, so make lint and CI never execute the new regression coverage
suggested_fix: Add test-brainstorm-prompts to .PHONY, one test-harnesses-N shard, a Makefile target, and docs/linting.md

scenario_or_breakage: The script schema changes, but the sibling contract still documents only partition_requested and explicitly says to update it on schema changes
suggested_fix: Update scripts/write-run-params.md usage/schema/update notes to include --brainstorm-requested and brainstorm_requested false-by-default semantics
